meta.subject: rop refactoring, bug fixes and optimizations

en.summary: Although the commit also refactors the ROP path, it clearly fixes fragment test and memory-update behavior. The patch adds face-specific stencil configuration, explicit depth/stencil/blend enable tracking, and corrected ROP memory sequencing so disabled or mismatched tests no longer drive the wrong updates.
why_it_counts: The patch changes core ROP RTL modules, not only tests or simulator code.
It adds missing control state for depth, stencil, and blend enable decisions.
The new memory and slice logic changes which fragment data is read, tested, and written back.
disqualifiers: The commit mixes refactoring, optimizations, and several fixes in one patch.
The exact intended bug list is not fully enumerated in the subject.
evidence: VX_rop_dcr.sv adds derived depth_enable, stencil_front_enable, stencil_back_enable, and blend_enable state instead of inferring behavior from partial fields.
VX_rop_ds.sv changes stencil_writemask from a shared mask to a per-lane face-selected mask.
VX_rop_slice.sv now selects front or back stencil control using backface state and explicitly tracks ds_enable, blend_enable, write_bypass, and read/write staging.
VX_rop_mem.sv adds req_ds_pass and req_backface, uses per-plane byte enables, and no longer relies on the old single write_mask/rsp_mask scheme.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A raster-operations stage must apply stencil and depth side effects using the per-fragment test state that actually applies to that primitive. In particular, front-facing and back-facing fragments can have different stencil enables and write masks. If the pipeline collapses those controls into one shared mask or ignores face selection when generating memory byte enables and test-driven updates, fragments update the wrong stencil bits or write data under the wrong test policy.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Front-facing and back-facing fragments use different stencil state, or some depth/stencil/blend stages are disabled while others remain enabled.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Replace face-specific stencil enable and writemask selection with a single shared setting, and let the memory-update path ignore that distinction.
portability_notes: Map this to any ROP or fragment-output stage that carries front/back stencil state separately.
The bug does not require the same module names; it only requires separate face-dependent test policy and a writeback path.
Leave color, depth, and blend arithmetic intact; only break the control logic that decides which stencil bytes are writable for a given face.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the logic that selects stencil function, operations, and write mask based on fragment face orientation.
Replace the face-selected write mask and enable with one shared mask or with the wrong face's settings.
Keep the downstream memory streamer or cache request format unchanged so only qualification of stencil writes regresses.
If the target DUT also computes explicit depth/stencil/blend enables, avoid changing those datapaths except where they feed face-specific stencil write qualification.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: ROP face-dependent stencil configuration and memory-update qualification
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix introduced explicit depth/stencil/blend enable bits, split stencil write masks by face, propagated backface information, and rewrote the memory request path so updates are qualified by the right test state.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In the ROP control path, collapse stencil_front_writemask and stencil_back_writemask back into one shared mask and remove the per-fragment backface-based selection that now feeds VX_rop_ds.sv, VX_rop_mem.sv, and VX_rop_slice.sv.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Back-facing or differently configured fragments update the wrong stencil bits, causing incorrect depth/stencil outcomes and visible render corruption in scenes that rely on asymmetric front/back stencil policy.
evidence_for_injection: The patch adds separate front and back stencil write masks and propagates backface state into the ROP datapath.
The old code used one stencil_writemask and a simpler request mask scheme, which is exactly the missing control distinction.
The rewritten memory path now carries req_ds_pass and req_backface, tying the fix to fragment-test-qualified updates rather than cosmetic refactoring.
notes: This commit contains multiple ROP fixes; the face-specific stencil-control bug is the cleanest portable injection target.
A regression test with different front/back stencil masks is the most direct exposure pattern.

zh.summary: 该提交虽然同时包含 ROP 重构，但其中明确修复了 fragment test 与内存更新行为。补丁加入了按正反面区分的 stencil 配置、显式的 depth/stencil/blend enable 跟踪，以及修正后的 ROP 内存时序，从而避免在测试被关闭或配置不匹配时写入错误的数据。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改的是核心 ROP RTL 模块，而不是仅改测试或模拟器。
它补上了 depth、stencil 和 blend 判定所缺失的控制状态。
新的 memory 与 slice 逻辑直接改变了 fragment 数据何时被读取、测试和写回。
disqualifiers: 该提交把重构、优化和多个修复混在了一起。
标题没有把所有具体修复点逐条写清。
evidence: VX_rop_dcr.sv 新增了派生的 depth_enable、stencil_front_enable、stencil_back_enable 和 blend_enable 状态，不再依赖零散字段间接推断行为。
VX_rop_ds.sv 把 stencil_writemask 从共享掩码改成了按 lane、按 face 选择的掩码。
VX_rop_slice.sv 现在会根据 backface 状态选择 front/back stencil 控制，并显式跟踪 ds_enable、blend_enable、write_bypass 与读写阶段。
VX_rop_mem.sv 新增了 req_ds_pass 和 req_backface，使用按 plane 的 byte enable，并不再依赖旧的单一 write_mask/rsp_mask 方案。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 光栅输出阶段必须依据真正适用于该 fragment 的测试状态来应用 stencil 与 depth 副作用。尤其是正面与背面 fragment 可能拥有不同的 stencil enable 和 write mask。如果流水线把这些控制折叠成一个共享掩码，或者在生成内存 byte enable 与测试驱动更新时忽略面朝向选择，那么 fragment 就会修改错误的 stencil 位，或者在错误的测试策略下写入数据。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 按面朝向区分的 stencil 更新资格判断
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 正面与背面 fragment 使用不同的 stencil 状态，或者 depth/stencil/blend 中只有部分阶段被启用。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 把按面朝向选择的 stencil enable 与 writemask 恢复成单一共享设置，并让内存更新路径忽略这种区分。
portability_notes: 可映射到任何把 front/back stencil 状态分开携带的 ROP 或 fragment-output 级。
该缺陷不依赖相同的模块名，只要求存在按面朝向区分的测试策略和写回路径。
保留 color、depth 和 blend 的计算逻辑不变，只破坏决定当前 face 允许写哪些 stencil 字节的控制逻辑。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到依据 fragment 面朝向选择 stencil function、operation 和 write mask 的逻辑。
把按面朝向选择的 write mask 和 enable 替换为单一共享掩码，或错误地总是选择另一面的设置。
保持下游 memory streamer 或 cache request 格式不变，只让 stencil 写资格判断退化。
如果目标 DUT 还会显式计算 depth/stencil/blend enable，只在这些信号喂给按面朝向 stencil 写资格判断的位置引入错误。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: ROP 中按正反面区分的 stencil 配置与内存更新资格判断
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复引入了显式的 depth/stencil/blend enable 位，把 stencil write mask 拆成正反面两套，传播了 backface 信息，并重写内存请求路径，使更新由正确的测试状态来限定。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 ROP 控制路径里，把 stencil_front_writemask 与 stencil_back_writemask 重新折叠成一个共享掩码，并删除当前向 VX_rop_ds.sv、VX_rop_mem.sv 和 VX_rop_slice.sv 提供按 fragment backface 选择控制的逻辑。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 背面或使用不同 stencil 配置的 fragment 会修改错误的 stencil 位，导致 depth/stencil 结果错误，并在依赖 front/back 非对称 stencil 策略的场景中出现可见渲染损坏。
evidence_for_injection: 补丁新增了独立的 front/back stencil write mask，并把 backface 状态传播进 ROP 数据通路。
旧代码只有一个 stencil_writemask 和更简单的 request mask 方案，正好缺少这一控制区分。
重写后的 memory 路径现在携带 req_ds_pass 和 req_backface，说明修复目标是按 fragment test 结果限定更新，而不是单纯重构。
notes: 该提交包含多个 ROP 修复点；按正反面区分的 stencil 控制错误是其中最适合可移植回注的故障。
一个使用不同 front/back stencil mask 的回归测试最容易直接暴露该问题。
